name: modulos-cliente-plus
description: Laboratório local para criar e testar novos módulos do Cliente Plus antes de levá-los ao projeto principal.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: node scripts/mvnw.mjs -q package -DskipTests && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/mvnw.mjs -q compile && npm run typecheck -w frontend
